title: Core Network selection for UEs not using CIoT 5GS optimizations

entities.name: UE capable of both N1 mode and S1 mode
entities.description: UE that supports both 5G NAS (N1 mode) and 4G NAS (S1 mode) operations.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management idle state where the UE is registered but has no active signaling connection.

entities.name: Disable N1 mode capability
entities.description: Procedure where UE disables N1 mode capability when 5GS lacks required functionalities but EPS supports them.

entities.name: Core network selection based on PLMN
entities.description: UE selects core network type (EPC or 5GCN) using PLMN selection procedures when lower layers indicate dual connectivity without target CN type.

entities.name: Core network selection for emergency calls
entities.description: UE selects core network type for emergency calls based on IMS emergency services support indication when in limited-service state.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: State where UE is deregistered and can only access limited services.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE is deregistered and limited to emergency services.

entities.name: Core network selection for EPC
entities.description: UE selects EPC when lower layers indicate target core network type EPC from NG-RAN.

entities.name: Core network selection for 5GCN
entities.description: UE selects 5GCN when lower layers indicate target core network type 5GCN from NG-RAN.

entities.name: EMM procedure
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management procedure initiated after EPC selection.

entities.name: 5GMM procedure
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management procedure initiated after 5GCN selection.

relations.description: N1 mode disable procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode.
PLMN-based CN selection requires UE to be capable of both N1 and S1 modes.
Emergency CN selection requires UE to be in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
Emergency CN selection requires UE to be in EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
EPC selection procedure includes initiating appropriate EMM procedure.
5GCN selection procedure includes initiating appropriate 5GMM procedure.
